<noinclude>{{DISPLAYTITLE:List of ''Pokémon Horizons: The Series'' episodes}}
This is a list of episodes of ''[[Pokémon Horizons: The Series]]'', which premiered on April 14, 2023 in Japan and on March 7, 2024 in the United States. These episodes follow [[Liko]] and [[Roy]], alongside the [[Rising Volt Tacklers]], in a search for the Pokémon known as [[Six Heroes]] and to discover the mysteries surrounding [[Pagogo|Terapagos]] and the Ancient Adventurer, [[Lucius]]. Following their every move is the [[Villainous team|villainous organization]] known as the [[Explorers]], who have their own goals regarding these same objectives.</noinclude>
